overview_description.description:
Pluto is the most comprehensive & powerful corporate card and spend management platform built for MENA businesses. 

From small businesses to the largest multi-national group holdings, businesses such as Property Finder, Knight Frank and Swissport have trusted Pluto with all of their non-payroll spending.

Pluto combines the power of getting access to instant issuance unlimited corporate cards, full end-to-end reimbursements, petty cash & account payables management all within one platform. 

No more chasing for receipts, manually approving invoices on long e-mail threads or sharing one corporate card with several people. Pluto's enterprise platform brings control back to complex finance and accounting business processes and creates a streamlined approach to controlling your company's spending.

about_short_description.short_description: Pluto Corporate Card & Spend Management platform for enterprises in MENA.

product.name: Pluto Corporate Cards
product.description: Prepaid physical and virtual Mastercard corporate cards for employee and business spending, with budgets, merchant controls, approval workflows, transaction monitoring, and cashback options.

product.name: Pluto Expense Management
product.description: A centralized expense management system for capturing, approving, monitoring, and reconciling company expenses, with policy controls, real-time reporting, receipt capture, and accounting synchronization.

product.name: Pluto Invoice Management
product.description: Accounts payable software that captures, extracts, reviews, approves, matches, and pays invoices using OCR, duplicate detection, workflow automation, ageing reports, and vendor payment capabilities.

product.name: Pluto Procure-to-Pay
product.description: Procurement orchestration software for managing purchase requests, approvals, vendors, purchase orders, goods receipt matching, invoices, payments, and procurement records in one workflow.

product.name: Pluto Employee Reimbursements
product.description: A travel and employee expense reimbursement module for submitting, approving, documenting, and paying out-of-pocket business expenses through configurable workflows and accounting integrations.

product.name: Pluto Petty Cash Management
product.description: A digital petty cash system for recording cash advances, ATM withdrawals, receipts, balances, approvals, and reconciliations by department, project, location, or employee.
